item_name: Rothco GI Style Aluminum Mess Kit
item_short_desc: Rothco's Aluminum Mess Kit is a must-have for outdoor enthusiasts, including campers, survivalists, and preppers. Made from durable and lightweight aluminum, this outdoor mess kit is perfect for taking on your next camping trip or storing in your bug out bag. The kit contains a pan and plate combo, making it versatile for various meal preparations. Its compact design ensures it can be easily stored in your camping or tactical bag without taking up too much space.
